draft.headline: Prioritize Usability next quarter, with a targeted access fix alongside
draft.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Put the main product effort into Usability. It ranks first on severity sum ({{C051}}) with a severity total of {{C055}} across {{C054}} complaints, and it also ranks first on complaint count ({{C053}}). Its mean severity ranks fourth ({{C052}}), so pair the Usability work with a targeted access fix rather than treating every Usability issue as equally severe. Playback ranks second on severity sum ({{C058}}).

## Evidence
The largest issue by severity, privacy concerns, maps outside the four areas and is not owned by this memo. Within Usability, `usability/ads` ranks third overall ({{C015}}) with a severity sum of {{C012}} and a mean of {{C013}}. Review `45e2aab4-449c-4c23-83d0-69bd568a9e08` describes unwanted songs interrupting listening, and `92bd7ff4-4322-4406-9033-f13e3079aa74` says there are too many ads. `usability/ui_layout` has a severity sum of {{C027}}, and review `e7747485-42c5-4bb9-b1e2-1b4044eedb5a` says the app is getting worse with each update. `usability/queue_playlist` ranks seventh ({{C035}}), and review `5185fc7e-8e72-45e4-8d85-91ab76c43fae` reports that liked songs fail to display.

## Recent trend
For June through October, Usability complaints rose from {{C17977}} in the earlier year to {{C32526}} in the later year. Billing/support rose from {{C3789}} to {{C30085}}, the largest rise among the four areas. Usability still has the highest complaint volume of the four areas in the later year, so the recommendation holds. Overall, the complaint share of classified records rose from {{C085}} to {{C17980}}, and cancellation-intent records rose from {{C086}} to {{C17981}}. These are observed changes, not causes, and cancellation language is stated intent rather than observed churn.

## Alternatives considered
Billing/support ranks second on complaint count ({{C067}}) and third on severity sum ({{C065}}), with a mean of {{C070}}. Its main issue, `billing/subscription_entitlement`, ranks second overall ({{C010}}), and review `4ff359d6-ce1b-4074-a63f-2e97e566d294` states intent to uninstall. Playback ranks second on severity sum ({{C058}}) and second on mean severity ({{C059}}, mean {{C063}}), but it ranks third on complaint count ({{C060}}). Its `playback/general` issue ranks fourth ({{C020}}), and review `557527a9-d504-4387-a2e5-47d80048747c` reports that the wrong song plays. Access ranks lowest on complaint count ({{C074}}) and fourth on severity sum ({{C072}}), but first on mean severity ({{C073}}, mean {{C077}}). Its `access/login_failure` issue ranks eighth ({{C040}}), and review `97be5642-eab6-45f4-9c08-3aa28cc8e8ac` reports being unable to log in.

## Limitations
Reviews are self-selected public app-store text. Cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn, and the trend changes are not causal. {{C32530}} records with empty review text were quarantined, and {{C32531}} records remained unclassified. Complaints outside the four areas account for a share of {{C082}} and carry {{C080}} in severity, so the four-area comparison covers only part of the complaint base.

draft.headline: Put next quarter's main effort into Usability, the first-ranked area on severity sum, while running a targeted Access fix
draft.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Put the main effort into Usability. It ranks first on severity sum ({{C055}} across {{C054}} complaints; rank {{C051}}) and has the largest complaint count of the four areas (rank {{C053}}). Its mean severity is lower ({{C056}}; rank {{C052}}), so this is a volume and impact call, not a per-complaint one. Access has the highest mean severity ({{C077}}; first on mean severity at {{C073}}) but ranks {{C072}} on severity sum, so it is a targeted follow-up, not the lead bet.

## Evidence
Usability's issues include `usability/ads` (severity sum {{C012}}), `usability/general` ({{C022}}), `usability/ui_layout` ({{C027}}) and `usability/queue_playlist` ({{C032}}). Review `45e2aab4-449c-4c23-83d0-69bd568a9e08` describes unrelated songs starting between ads, and `92bd7ff4-4322-4406-9033-f13e3079aa74` cites too many ads. Review `e7747485-42c5-4bb9-b1e2-1b4044eedb5a` says the interface is getting worse with each update (`usability/ui_layout`). Review `5185fc7e-8e72-45e4-8d85-91ab76c43fae` reports liked songs going blank (`usability/queue_playlist`). The single largest issue is `other/general` privacy concerns ({{C002}}; rank {{C005}}), which sits outside the four areas.

## Recent trend
Comparing the same five months across the two years, Usability complaints rose from {{C17977}} in the earlier period to {{C32527}} in the later period. Usability stayed the largest of the four areas in both periods (earlier {{C17977}} against Billing/support at {{C3789}}; later {{C32527}} against {{C30085}}). Billing/support rose the most among the four areas, from {{C3789}} to {{C30085}}. Playback moved from {{C12433}} to {{C12507}}, and Access from {{C2111}} to {{C5461}}. Outside the four areas rose from {{C8360}} to {{C80853}}. Complaint share of classified records moved from {{C085}} to {{C17980}}, and cancellation-intent records moved from {{C086}} to {{C17981}}. These changes are observed, not caused by any one area. The recommendation still holds because Usability is still the largest area in the later period, but Billing/support is a second watch item.

## Alternatives considered
Billing/support ranks {{C065}} on severity sum ({{C069}}; mean {{C070}}). Review `c917e047-2d4b-41c5-ad41-bc9355b6d6e4` says premium gating forces users to pay, and review `4ff359d6-ce1b-4074-a63f-2e97e566d294` states intent to uninstall, which is stated intent rather than observed churn. Playback ranks {{C058}} on severity sum ({{C062}}; mean {{C063}}, rank {{C059}}). Review `557527a9-d504-4387-a2e5-47d80048747c` reports the wrong song playing, and `ec296b31-61cb-4588-ba80-e8ab992b2281` reports the app not staying on. Access ranks {{C072}} on severity sum ({{C076}}) but leads on mean severity ({{C077}}). Reviews `663a93eb-c77a-4b86-a883-c98889ac5f11` and `97be5642-eab6-45f4-9c08-3aa28cc8e8ac` describe login failures (`access/login_failure`, mean {{C038}}).

## Limitations
{{C32530}} records were quarantined for empty review text, and {{C32531}} records were unclassified because they were pending or failed. Reviews are self-selected public app-store text. Cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn. Severity values are not revenue, and no revenue, churn or causal estimate is made. Overall completed records total {{C32528}}, with {{C32529}} complaint or cancellation records and {{C32532}} cancellation-intent records.
